misprints.note: The last letter is printed as u, probably a turned n.
The article is printed with a circumflex.
The accent looks grave even though punctuation follows.

uncertain.note: The accent on omega is small and could be an acute rather than a grave.
The iota subscripts are faint or broken in the print. I kept them.
The mark after dta is a heavy dot. It could be a comma.
The umlaut on ö is broken and looks like a tilde.
The breathing over υ is small. I read it as rough.
